name: get_shop_context
description: Call this first, as soon as the shopkeeper answers. Returns who the shop is, last week's order, overdue credit, current offers, out-of-stock items and the full product catalog with codes and prices.

from_number.description: The from_number given in the call details

to_number.description: The to_number given in the call details

execution_id.description: The execution_id given in the call details

name: place_order
description: Book the shop's order once they have said everything they want. Pass every item as CODE:quantity separated by commas, using product codes from the catalog, e.g. PG100:12, MG70:3. Calling it again in the same call replaces the earlier order, so always send the full list.

items.description: Full order as CODE:quantity, comma separated. Quantity is in the catalog pack unit (box, case, bag, carton, crate).

from_number.description: The from_number given in the call details

to_number.description: The to_number given in the call details

execution_id.description: The execution_id given in the call details

name: log_payment_promise
description: Record when the shopkeeper will pay their overdue balance. Only use after they have named an amount and a date.

amount.description: Rupees they will pay, digits only, e.g. 4800

promise_date.description: Date they will pay, as YYYY-MM-DD

from_number.description: The from_number given in the call details

to_number.description: The to_number given in the call details

execution_id.description: The execution_id given in the call details

name: schedule_callback
description: Use when the shopkeeper is busy or asks to be called later. Ask what time first.

callback_at.description: When to call back, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in India time

from_number.description: The from_number given in the call details

to_number.description: The to_number given in the call details

execution_id.description: The execution_id given in the call details
